checks.text: The page heading reads "Interval Timer" and the tab labelled "Timer" is visible and active.
Typing "30" in the field labelled "Work (sec)" and "15" in the field labelled "Rest (sec)", then clicking "Start", shows the BigClock displaying "00:30" and the phase label "Work".
After the work phase completes, the phase label changes to "Rest" and the BigClock displays "00:15".
After the rest phase completes, the phase label changes to "Work" and the round counter shows "Round 2".
Clicking the button "Pause" stops the countdown; the BigClock remains static and the button label changes to "Resume".
Clicking "Resume" restarts the countdown from the paused time.
Clicking the button "Stop" resets the timer to "00:00", the phase label to "Ready", and the round counter to "Round 1".
On the tab labelled "History", after completing one full cycle (work + rest), a list item appears containing "Round 1", "Work: 30s", and "Rest: 15s".
Reload keeps the timer state: after starting a 30-second work phase and reloading the page, the BigClock displays the remaining time and the phase label shows "Work".
